split: same four leave-one-video-out folds as ResNet
features: mean and 90th-percentile absolute grayscale differences at lags 1 and 3 frames; each raw feature plus past-only 15-frame mean and standard deviation (12 features)
preprocessing: same normalized 224x224 channel crops; interior pixels [22:202,22:202]; grayscale /255; no intensity/static appearance features
classifier: StandardScaler + class-balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 seed=0
training: every tenth frame; exclude +/-5 experimental seconds around OT; same labels as ResNet
initial_history: zero difference where history unavailable; no future frames
